description: This PHP source file defines the AuthorizationCodeRepository class within the OrangeHRM project. It implements OAuth2 authorization code handling by persisting new auth codes, revoking existing codes, and checking if a code is revoked. It interacts with the Doctrine ORM for database operations and adheres to the OAuth2 standards via the League OAuth2 Server package.

classes.name: AuthorizationCodeRepository
classes.description: Repository class handling OAuth2 authorization code persistence, revocation, and validation, extending BaseDao and implementing AuthCodeRepositoryInterface.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Creates and persists a new OAuth authorization code entity based on the provided AuthCodeEntityInterface.

methods.name: revokeAuthCode
methods.description: Marks an existing authorization code as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks if the given authorization code has been revoked or not.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Returns a new instance of AuthCodeEntity.
